exposure: Evidence-Based Practice (EBP) guideline to prevent and treat breast engorgement
outcome: Staff nurses' knowledge on prevention and treatment of breast engorgement
Early initiation of breast feeding practices
cohort: The study included 50 prime post-caesarean mothers and 20 staff nurses from KMC Hospital Attawar, Mangalore.
finding: The study revealed that most of the post-caesarean mothers were practicing early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: The study's findings, indicating that most post-caesarean mothers practiced early initiation of breastfeeding, are specific to the caesarean mode of birth.
